newsitem.title: USA: T. Rowe Price sees Q1 EPS up 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: T. Rowe Price sees Q1 EPS up 30 pct.

text.p: T. Rowe Price Associates Inc said Thursday that it expects about a 25 percent increase in revenues and a more than 30 percent increase in earnings for the first quarter of this year compared with the first quarter of 1996.
The company earned $20.4 million, or $0.33 a share in the first quarter of 1996, on revenues of $132.4 million.
The company said that net cash flows into the mutual funds were strong during the first quarter, and about $3.4 billion in net cash flows went into T. Rowe Price funds in the quarter.
But Georege Roche, the company's new president, said that the outlook for the remainder of 1997 remains uncertain due to its dependence on future Federal Reserve policy.

"Economic growth remains good and inflation is still at a modest level," he said at the annual shareholders meeting. "The Fed, nevertheless, may determine that it needs to maintain a tight monetary policy to contain inflationary pressures. Although the financial markets have already discounted some modest interest rate increases, if the Fed continues to tighten monetary policy, stock and bond markets could be in for further correction."
